name: How do I choose the right contractor for a stone retaining wall project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a stone retaining wall project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, prioritize experience with stone retaining walls, proper licensing, and insurance. Look for a portfolio of completed projects, ask for references, and ensure they offer a detailed, written contract. A reputable contractor will conduct a thorough site evaluation, discuss design options, and provide a transparent quote. They should also be knowledgeable about local building codes and permit requirements. Choose a team that communicates clearly and inspires confidence in their expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, insurance, portfolio, references, clear communication, and knowledge of local building codes.
